Netanyahu Thanks Indian Pilot for Evacuating Israelis from Dubai

Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu spoke via video call with Captain Smit Machhar, the Indian pilot of a Dubai-bound flight, on Saturday evening. Netanyahu called Captain Machhar a hero for Israel, India, and the world, and invited him to light a torch at Israel's Independence Day ceremony. The conversation occurred during the flight.
